name: RAND
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A raw percussion synth: one voice, eight steps, a clock that turns into a tone
description: A semi-modular style percussion synth in the spirit of the Behringer EDGE and Moog DFAM: two oscillators with FM and hard sync, noise, a 24 dB ladder filter (low and high pass), pitch, filter and amp envelopes and drive. An 8-step sequencer with two rows, pitch and velocity, whose clock runs from quarter speed up to x128, where the rhythm turns into a tone; five held keys jump the clock at once. Eight presets, random rows, pads, MIDI clock and transport in to follow a drum machine.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
